literal_meaning: রস ঝরার শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic sound of dripping juice)
example_sentences_in_bangla: লেবুগুলো এত টসটস যে চিবিয়ে খেলে রস মুখে ছড়িয়ে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mangoes are so ripe and juicy.
The lemons are dripping with juice when you bite into them.
note: This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking the sound of juice from ripe fruits, commonly used in Bengali agrarian contexts.
